options.name: action
options.description: Specifies the operation to perform. C(copy) to perform and alternate disk copy. C(clean) to cleanup an existing alternate disk copy. C(install) to install filesets, fixes in existing alternate disk. C(wakeup) to performs a wake-up on the root volume group located on the target_disk. C(sleep) to sleep the alternate root volume group that experienced the previous "wake" operation.

options.name: allow_old_rootvg
options.description: Allows the removal or cleanup of existing old rootvg as well.

options.name: apar_fixes
options.description: Optional file with a list of APARs to install after a clone of rootvg. If apar_fixes is provided then I(image_location) must be provided.

options.name: bootlist
options.description: When I(action=copy), specifies to run bootlist after the alternate disk copy.

options.name: bundle_name
options.description: Path name of optional file with a list of packages or filesets that will be installed after a rootvg clone. If specified then I(image_location) must be provided.

options.name: device_reset
options.description: When I(action=copy), specifies to reset any user-defined device configurations on the target C(altinst_rootvg).

options.name: disk_size_policy
options.description: When I(action=copy), specifies how to choose the alternate disk if I(targets) is not specified. C(minimize) smallest disk that can be selected. C(upper) first disk found bigger than the rootvg disk. C(lower) disk size less than rootvg disk size but big enough to contain the used PPs. C(nearest) disk size closest to the rootvg disk.

options.name: existing_altinst_rootvg
options.description: When I(action=install), specifies the target disk where bundle_name/fixes/filesets will be installed.

options.name: filesets
options.description: List of filesets to install after cloning a rootvg. If specified then I(image_location) must be provided.

options.name: first_boot_script
options.description: When I(action=copy), specifies an optional customization script to run during the initial boot of the alternate rootvg, after all file systems are mounted.

options.name: force
options.description: Forces removal of any existing alternate disk copy on target disks.

options.name: image_location
options.description: Location of installp images or updates to apply after a clone of rootvg. This can be a directory full path name or device name.

options.name: installp_flags
options.description: The flags to use when updating or installing new filesets into the cloned altinst_rootvg. If specified then I(image_location) must be provided.

options.name: phases_to_execute
options.description: When I(action=copy), specifies the phase or phases to execute during this invocation of alt_disk_copy. C(1) only phases 1 to execute C(2) only phases 2 to execute C(3) only phases 3 to execute C(12) phases 1 and phases 2 to execute C(23) phases 2 and phases 3 to execute C(all) all phases to execute (default)

options.name: rebuild_boot_image
options.description: Rebuilds the alternate boot image before putting the volume group to sleep.

options.name: remain_nim_client
options.description: When I(action=copy), specifies to copy the C(/.rhosts) and C(/etc/niminfo) files to the alternate rootvg.

options.name: resolvconf
options.description: When I(action=copy), specifies the C(resolv.conf) file to replace the existing one after the rootvg has been cloned.

options.name: skip_disk_bootability_checks
options.description: When I(action=copy), skips disk bootability checks.

options.name: targets
options.description: Specifies the target disks. Either I(targets) or I(disk_size_policy) must be specified. If no I(targets) disk is specified, it will look for a valid candidate disk based on the provided I(disk_size_policy) policy.
